title: Skillet Cornbread
description: Crisp-bottomed cornbread from a hot iron pan.
imageAlt: Golden cornbread in a cast-iron skillet with a wedge cut out

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.text: Put a 10-inch iron skillet in the oven and heat to 425°F.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and kosher salt in a large bowl. In a second bowl, whisk the buttermilk and 2 eggs, then stir in 4 tablespoons melted butter. Stir the wet mixture into the dry mixture just until combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Use oven mitts to take the hot skillet out of the oven. Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in it, pour in the batter, and return the skillet to the oven. Bake until golden and set, 18 to 20 minutes.
